_comment: Columns a REAL person's story needs: the History Writer's ledger (docs/HISTORY_WRITER_ARCHITECTURE.md §2 D3, history/voice.md §8). The LitRPG idea for people who lived: what changes over a life (trade, standing, resources, skills, household, residence, legal status) is TIME-VARYING, so every change is a dated fact edge with its source, and 'what was true of her as of chapter 6' is answerable. Nothing here is ever printed as a stat or a level; the prose shows each change in action. Every value must come from a source: put the source id and verbatim quote in the fact's evidence. Read by StoryMaker's pack catalog (BiblePackCatalog) and applied additively, keyed on packKey. DECODER SAFETY: comment keys at this TOP LEVEL ONLY; every field object is fixed-field.
_fieldNotes: promptTier: always = injected every call; whenRelevant = when the entity is retrieved; onDemand = by tool only. isTimeVarying: true routes writes to the fact ledger (dated, sourced, never overwritten). aiVisible: false keeps a column out of prompts entirely.

person.name: Born
person.llmHint: Date and place exactly as the source gives them; write 'c.' only when the source does.

person.name: Died
person.llmHint: Date and place as the source gives them. Blank if no source says.

person.name: Came from
person.llmHint: Where they came from before the place the story is set, as the source says it.

person.name: Identity (as sourced)
person.llmHint: Only what self-identification or a reliable biography establishes, with the source. Never inferred from a name, a photograph or a neighbourhood.

person.name: Trade
person.llmHint: Work as the sources name it, dated. A change of trade is a turning point the prose shows.

person.name: Standing
person.llmHint: Offices, memberships, titles and firsts, each dated. Keep titles exactly (Reverend, Doctor, Chief).

person.name: Resources
person.llmHint: Property, a business, money — what they owned or lost, dated, with the figures the source gives.

person.name: Skills
person.llmHint: Trades learned, languages, literacy, licences — each when the record first shows it in use.

person.name: Household
person.llmHint: Marriage, children, boarders, family who joined them — dated. Name no living private person without a public source.

person.name: Residence
person.llmHint: Where they lived, dated, as an address or neighbourhood the source gives.

person.name: Legal status
person.llmHint: Citizenship, exclusion, incarceration, removal — stated plainly in those words, dated.

person.name: In their own words
person.llmHint: Short verbatim passages from their letters, testimony or interviews, each with its source. The only words a story may put in quotation marks.

institution.name: Founded
institution.llmHint: Date and founders as the source gives them.

institution.name: What it did
institution.llmHint: In its own words where a source records them.

event.name: What it cost
event.llmHint: What it cost the people in it — money, standing, safety — as the sources record it.

era.name: Place
era.llmHint: The city, district or street this context is about.

era.name: Context
era.llmHint: Sourced period detail — wages, prices, who held office, what the street looked like. Every sentence a claim; at most 30% of a chapter.

source.name: Publisher
source.llmHint: The unit of independence: several items from one publisher count once.
